Harvard does not require TOEFL

For first-year applications to Harvard College, an English test is optional, not required. The SAT or ACT is required, with limited exceptions. Not required doesn't mean the score doesn't matter. The decision is entirely Harvard's.

Source: college.harvard.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

After 21 January 2026, your TOEFL score runs from 1 to 6

Caltech: 5 (100 on the old scale)
Twente (September 2027): 5 (100 on the old scale)
Tilburg (September 2027): 5 (4.5 for February 2027 entry)
Imperial Standard: 4.5 (92 on the old scale)
UC Berkeley: 4.5 (90 on the old scale)
UT Austin: 4 (79 on the old scale)

On the new scale, the overall score is the average of the four sections. Until 2028, ETS also shows the old equivalent on score reports. Confirm with the university.

Source: ets.org, admissions.caltech.edu, utwente.nl, tilburguniversity.edu, imperial.ac.uk, admissions.berkeley.edu, admissions.utexas.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

“No school in the USA asks for the SAT anymore”

The truth: Many schools have made it required again. Harvard, Yale, MIT and Stanford ask for the SAT or ACT. It is optional at Duke and Vanderbilt. At Princeton it is optional in 2027 and required in 2028.

Source: college.harvard.edu, admissions.yale.edu, mitadmissions.org, admission.stanford.edu, admissions.duke.edu, admissions.vanderbilt.edu, admission.princeton.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Columbia's minimum: IELTS 7.5, TOEFL 105

Columbia asks for at least IELTS 7.5 or TOEFL iBT 105 for bachelor's applications. The page gives no new TOEFL scale equivalent, so confirm before you apply. Applicants with SAT reading and writing 700+ or ACT English or Reading section 29+ are exempt.

Source: undergrad.admissions.columbia.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

How numerus fixus programs work in the Netherlands

1. What it is: Programs with limited places. You apply through Studielink by 15 January, 23:59 (CET).
2. Selection process: The institution makes its selection between 15 January and 15 April. On 15 April you see your ranking number in Studielink.
3. Limits: At most two numerus fixus programs a year. Only one application in medicine, dentistry, dental hygiene and physiotherapy.
4. The offer: Accept within two weeks or the place goes to someone else. With fewer applicants than places, everyone gets an offer on 15 April.

The general date for other programs is 1 May. Institutions may set earlier dates for non-EU applicants.

Source: studyinnl.org (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
Irvine's yearly bill for out-of-state students: $59,375

An out-of-state bachelor's student starting in fall 2026 pays $59,375 in 2026-27. Of that, $39,270 is the out-of-state surcharge and $3,214 is health insurance. International students pay this too. Fall 2027 rates may differ. Housing is separate.

Source: reg.uci.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
